rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 0 raw:1 names 'the map' (H1), prior context for every later chunk. Chunk 1 raw:3 'Back to the map: the far half opens' + raw:7 'The map lights its other side now. Verification, Absorption, Outcome. The rest of the training goes there, starting with the session you send off in this module.' 'The map' is arc-earned spine vocabulary named in this rule's own carve-out list verbatim ('the map, the loop, the practice at M4+'), and 'Verification, Absorption, Outcome' are freshly-named nouns, not unresolved pronouns — they caption the same chunk's figure (SVG text elements read 'Verification'/'Absorption'/'Outcome' at y=44, plus 'THE FAR HALF · AHEAD' caption), so the naming is visual-and-textual in the same chunk, then immediately defined one chunk later — not a forward reference to a missing slide. 'The session you send off in this module' is self-explanatory forward framing (no external artifact required to parse it), matching the module-arc-beats-in-openers carve-out for a container opener naming what the module holds. Chunk 2 closest candidate: raw:14 'whether any of it crosses the wall from you to the team' — 'the wall' is not named earlier in THIS file (it is formally coined as law:crosses-the-wall two modules later in the-map-filled-in.md, M6), but the phrase is self-parsing plain-English metaphor ('crosses X from you to the team') needing no prior naming to resolve, and this rule's own carve-out text states that premature use of not-yet-earned spine vocabulary is check_writing.md §14 territory, not a slides-class referent failure. No never-named, vague-with-history, or re-chunk-stranded referent found in-scope for this rule.

Manual scan of raw:1-16 for callback phrasing ('the opening lecture said', 'earlier lecture', 'this workbook', 'the prework at the top') -> 0 hits. raw:3 'Back to the map' names the training's own spine artifact by concept, never by file or page position. raw:11 'So far you sat inside every loop' characterizes the whole prior arc generically (M1-M3), not a specific document referenced by position — sibling of the module-ranges arc-lecture carve-out at L25. No sentence points at another file by position.
